prompts.title: Aggregate
prompts.detail: Primary message: Keep existing suppliers, add more supply, use one integration. Layout left to right: on the left THREE small distinct source trays stacked vertically with exact short labels "Marketplaces", "Aggregators", "Direct suppliers". Each tray contains only two overlapping miniature experience-card faces, giving diversity without clutter; one of the trays shows an ivory existing-connection marker. Three smooth coral connectors converge at one understated, thin bronze/coral junction in center labeled "Bridgify". Only ONE connector exits toward ONE larger clean ivory catalog on the right, labeled "Your catalog", containing three tidy photo rows representing museum, food tour, boat tour. Above that single outgoing connector use exact short label "One integration". The single unified catalog is the focal point, sources are quieter but legible. Concept is supply breadth through one connection, not de-duplication. No fourth source, no massive container around all objects. Elegant tangible product model with coherent depth and practical clarity.

Three visual groups at most, one obvious reading direction, one dominant outcome, no tangled cables. Do not draw the site's left text or navigation.

prompts.title: Normalize
prompts.detail: Primary message: Three inconsistent records of the SAME museum experience become one clean usable record. Layout left to right: on left a loose but orderly fan of THREE modest dark data cards, each with a photo of exactly the same Colosseum, subtly different crops and different metadata row lengths; this visibly communicates duplicate records, not different attractions. Tiny header above left group "Different sources". Three short paths merge through one narrow coral-lit normalization seam in the center (not a giant hub). On right ONE larger ivory, precise experience card with same Colosseum photograph, exact title "Colosseum visit", below it three aligned concise rows labeled "Content", "Availability", "Booking". Small coral check beside each, one discreet label at top "One clean record". No prices, numbers, claims about lowest price, or API code. Output card is dominant, input duplicate cards slightly recessed, enough separation to read the transformation at a glance. Mature sculptural UI illustration, no huge text.

prompts.title: Distribute
prompts.detail: Primary message: The same experience is sold inside YOUR channels under YOUR brand. Layout left to right: left ONE compact ivory experience card showing Colosseum museum trip, labeled "One experience". A short coral connector reaches a neat branching point then four smooth separated short paths fan to the right: FOUR modest branded channel surfaces in a compact two-by-two arrangement. Top-left a phone labeled "App", top-right a browser labeled "Site", bottom-left a slim checkout surface labeled "Booking flow", bottom-right an elegant loyalty card surface labeled "Rewards". All four display the SAME Colosseum thumbnail and the SAME minimal "Your brand" identity using cream/coral, with tiny coral booking action bars, demonstrating continuity, not four separate travel providers. The outgoing channel group is dominant but interfaces deliberately sparse. No Bridgify branding on customer-facing surfaces, no supplier logos. At bottom one short shared caption "Your channels. Your brand." High-end 3D product diorama with restrained relief, clear connections, ample negative space. Keep all four channel labels highly legible and no additional text.

prompts.title: Personalize
prompts.detail: Primary message: Traveler intent and trip context guide relevant recommendations, reducing choice overload. Three connected visual groups left-to-right: left a small elegant dark traveler-context card with a simple outlined person silhouette and just three ivory pills "Rome", "Culture", "For two". Center a discreet small warm coral recommendation junction labeled "AIyelet", with only one input and two output paths. Right one premium ivory panel labeled "Picked for you" showing TWO curated experience cards: dominant front card with warm Colosseum image titled "Ancient Rome tour", one slightly smaller second card with a museum/gallery artwork photo titled "Museum visit". Both relevant to Rome and Culture, no unrelated mountain/beach filler. A small coral check or selection rim links the Culture pill to the two results, without numerical match scores or claims. No brain or robot, no magic sparkles, no dense dashboard. Use short footer annotation "Illustrative match" discreetly. The recommendation panel is the clear focal point; traveler context stays secondary. This represents fitting experiences to intent, not identity profiling or surveillance. Consistent warm shallow-3D product render and calm precise typography.
